name: quota-display-only
goal: Verify that only the Mac shows subscription setup while Hub and iPhone display readings or Mac setup guidance.

evidence: Hub Home offered a setup button while the Mac had no setup action. Daniel specified that setup belongs on the Mac and Hub and iPhone should display readings or Mac guidance.
The existing Hub design asserted the former web action. The native fixture asserted quota readings and revocation but did not cover setup placement. Existing cases now assert both boundaries.
